shadows.label: 阴影 1 - Shadow 1
shadows.description: Background: `#FFFFFF` light / `#242526` dark, shadow `rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 0 4px 16px`, 500pt radius pill

borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Divider (`#E4E6EB`): Hairlines between comments, action rows.

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: Separator Bar (`#CED0D4`): Thicker separator between feed sections (rare).

borders.label: 边框 4 - Border 4
borders.description: Story Ring (Gradient): `#C13584` → `#E1306C` → `#FD1D1D` → `#F77737` (pink → red → orange) — inherited from Instagram's story ring, used on Facebook Stories.

borders.label: 边框 5 - Border 5
borders.description: Color does three jobs on Facebook: Facebook Blue (`#1877F2`) is the brand — it paints the top nav bar, the "Like" thumbs-up icon when active, the primary CTA (Login, Post, Send), and any "Facebook" self-reference. The reactions system is its own palette — Love is a coral-pink heart (`#F3425F`), Haha/Wow/Sad share an amber yellow (`#F7B928`), Angry is an orange-red (`#E9710F`), Care is a warm yellow-hug (`#F7B928`). And the informational green (`#42B72A`, sometimes the "Create Post" green) tips users toward creation actions. Everything else is neutral gray — post metadata, timestamps, comment bubbles, dividers. The result is a chromatic app that uses color to signal role, not to decorate.

borders.label: 边框 6 - Border 6
borders.description: Card White (`#FFFFFF`): Post cards, story thumbnails, profile cover, modals.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use soft gray {#F0F2F5} as the light canvas — it's the between-card space that defines Facebook's rhythm。
建议：Put every feed item in a white rounded card (8pt radius) — Facebook is the most card-based of social apps。
建议：Use Facebook Blue {#1877F2} for the brand, active Like, primary CTAs, and links — consistently。
建议：Keep the 5-tab bottom bar: Home / Video / Marketplace / Notifications / Menu — with labels always shown。
建议：Use the Reactions popover on long-press — 7 emoji in a horizontal floating pill, each scaling as the user drags across。
dont: 避免：use pure black canvas — Facebook's light mode canvas is {#F0F2F5}, dark is {#18191A}。
避免：hide tab labels — Facebook shows them; this is a deliberate choice for accessibility and utility。
避免：add colors beyond the Reactions palette — the 7 reaction colors are the expressive palette, nothing else。
避免：use heavy drop shadows on cards — the gray canvas does the separation work。
避免：use fancy custom fonts — the current app uses SF Pro, not Klavika or Helvetica Neue。
